tests.prompt: How long does delivery take, and how do I track my order?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: estimated delivery times are shown at checkout and in the shipping confirmation email, and processing takes 1-2 business days before dispatch; once the order ships a tracking link is emailed, and account holders can find tracking under My Orders. Does not invent specific dates or carriers, and does not redirect to the phone line.

tests.prompt: I bought a jacket two weeks ago but it doesn't fit. Can I still return it?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if unused and in original packaging, so two weeks is inside the window; starting a return means contacting support with the order number. May note that for a change-of-mind return the return shipping can be deducted from the refund. Does not invent a different return window.

tests.prompt: You received my return five days ago. When do I get my money back?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: refunds go back to the original payment method after the return is received and inspected, and typically take 3-10 business days depending on the bank or provider. Does not promise a specific payout date and does not claim to look up the refund.

tests.prompt: Why was my card declined at checkout?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: common causes are incorrect billing details, insufficient funds, bank security checks, or limits on international and online purchases, and suggests trying again, using another payment method, or contacting the bank. Does not claim to see the actual transaction.

tests.prompt: I can't remember my password, how do I get back into my account?
tests.expected: Answers from the FAQ: use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page, and a reset email is sent if the address matches an account. Does not ask for the password or other credentials.

tests.prompt: Where exactly is my parcel right now? Order 88123, it should have arrived yesterday.
tests.expected: Explains that this specific order cannot be resolved over chat and gives the support phone line +1-800-555-0199 with the hours Monday-Friday, excluding holidays. May reference the FAQ guidance to check tracking first. Must not invent a parcel location, tracking number, or delivery date.

Recognises this as a bug report and asks, in one short message, for both the steps to reproduce the problem and the customer's environment (browser, operating system, or device). Does not create a ticket yet, does not invent a browser or OS, and does not answer as an FAQ or hand off to the phone line.

tests.prompt: I add a hoodie to the cart, go to checkout, fill in my address and click Pay, and the page just reloads with an empty cart. I'm on Chrome 141 on Windows 11.
tests.expected: Files a bug report ticket and confirms it in one or two sentences, quoting the returned ticket ID (a UUID) and saying the team will follow up. Does not ask further questions, since the description, the steps to reproduce, and the environment were all provided. Does not promise a fix date, refund, or discount.

tests.prompt: 아이폰 사파리에서 프로모션 코드 SAVE10을 입력하고 적용을 누르면 코드가 유효하지 않다는 오류가 계속 나옵니다. 어제까지는 잘 됐어요.
tests.expected: Files a bug report ticket about the promo code SAVE10 being rejected and confirms it in Korean, quoting the returned ticket ID. The environment (iPhone Safari) and the steps were given, so it does not ask follow-up questions. Does not promise that the code will be honoured or offer a discount.

tests.prompt: The order summary shows $58 but the confirmation email charged me $85. Something in your app is swapping the numbers.
tests.expected: Treats this as a bug report about mismatched totals rather than an FAQ answer about payments. Either asks once for the missing steps to reproduce and the environment, or files a ticket and quotes the returned ticket ID. Does not promise a refund and does not explain payment authorisation policy instead of handling the bug.

tests.prompt: Hi, I run a logistics startup and I'd like to talk to someone about a partnership.
tests.expected: Politely acknowledges the request, explains that a member of the support team can help directly, and gives the phone line +1-800-555-0199 with the hours Monday-Friday, excluding holidays. Does not quote FAQ policy, does not create a bug ticket, and does not invent an email address, form, or contact person.

tests.prompt: Stop with the bots. I want to speak to an actual person right now.
tests.expected: Responds calmly, says a member of the support team can help, and gives the phone line +1-800-555-0199 with the hours Monday-Friday, excluding holidays. Does not argue, does not attempt to answer an unstated question, and does not promise an immediate callback.

tests.prompt: Good morning! Just wondering, who designs your packaging? It's lovely.
tests.expected: Warmly acknowledges the compliment, explains the support team can help with questions like this, and gives the phone line +1-800-555-0199 with the hours Monday-Friday, excluding holidays. Does not invent a designer, brand story, or supplier name, and does not create a bug ticket.
